fields.name: GroupId
fields.about: The group identifier.

fields.name: MemberId
fields.about: The member ID.

fields.name: ShareSessionEpoch
fields.about: The current share session epoch: 0 to open a share session; -1 to close it; otherwise increments for consecutive requests.

fields.name: MaxWaitMs
fields.about: The maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the response.

fields.name: MinBytes
fields.about: The minimum bytes to accumulate in the response.

fields.name: MaxBytes
fields.about: The maximum bytes to fetch. See KIP-74 for cases where this limit may not be honored.

fields.name: MaxRecords
fields.about: The maximum number of records to fetch. This limit can be exceeded for alignment of batch boundaries.

fields.name: BatchSize
fields.about: The optimal number of records for batches of acquired records and acknowledgements.

fields.name: Topics
fields.about: The topics to fetch.

fields.name: TopicId
fields.about: The unique topic ID.

fields.name: Partitions
fields.about: The partitions to fetch.

fields.name: PartitionIndex
fields.about: The partition index.

fields.name: PartitionMaxBytes
fields.about: The maximum bytes to fetch from this partition. 0 when only acknowledgement with no fetching is required. See KIP-74 for cases where this limit may not be honored.

fields.name: AcknowledgementBatches
fields.about: Record batches to acknowledge.

fields.name: FirstOffset
fields.about: First offset of batch of records to acknowledge.

fields.name: LastOffset
fields.about: Last offset (inclusive) of batch of records to acknowledge.

fields.name: AcknowledgeTypes
fields.about: Array of acknowledge types - 0:Gap,1:Accept,2:Release,3:Reject.

fields.name: ForgottenTopicsData
fields.about: The partitions to remove from this share session.

fields.name: TopicId
fields.about: The unique topic ID.

fields.name: Partitions
fields.about: The partitions indexes to forget.
